integrity: Exact finite combinatorial and acyclic discrete-Morse certificate, with independently recomputed mod-two ranks; no independent external audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite vertex-metric Vietoris–Rips scale two only, connected Petersen graph deletions of at most three edges; no continuous metric realization, larger faults, other radii or persistence maps. Literature uniqueness beyond inspected sources is unproven.
title: Sharp three-edge fault threshold for the radius-two Petersen Rips complex
